brief:
The US Senate is edging closer to holding a floor vote on Israeli accountability for American citizens killed in the occupied West Bank, according to a Democratic senator, Middle East Eye reported. Nine US citizens have been killed by Israelis in the territory over the past four years.

The development signals potential momentum for legislation addressing civilian deaths, though the measure still faces procedural hurdles before a formal vote can occur.

title: Senate moves toward vote on Israeli accountability for US citizen deaths
